_comment: Reuse registry for the shared permission templates in Protocol/contracts/templates. These are CONFIGURABLE SINGLETONS: deployed ONCE per chain, then every SMA reuses that address via attach + configure (no per-SMA deploy). Keyed by chainId then by the Solidity contract name. All six bind to the current CREATE2 kernel 0x02ABC18B65A328de2e749F56ba79ACF2718a6659 (same address on every chain). Deployed by 0xB01dCE443d052e44b7D13726c0EC9fFB7f5815B6 on 2026-06-23.
_testInstancesComment: NON-canonical instances deployed for testing only — NOT the registered production singletons in `chains`. Keyed chainId -> contract -> {address, ...}. catalog.mjs surfaces these with a TEST flag; do not use them for production registration.

SwapPermission.note: WARNING: built from CURRENT Protocol source (v2) but the LIVE Unichain kernel 0x02ABC…6659 (deployed 2026-06-23) is a pre-#59 "v1" snapshot WITHOUT registrationEpoch. configureDirect/configure call kernel.registrationEpoch and therefore ALWAYS REVERT against the live kernel — this instance cannot be configured on-chain as-is. The canonical chains.130.SwapPermission (0xb4111e…535B1) is the matching v1 (EIP712 domain "1", no epoch binding). v2 allow/deny logic + this oracle were verified on a fork against a v2-compatible mock kernel (1 allow + 6 deny). To use v2 on Unichain, redeploy the v2 kernel+templates together; otherwise keep using the v1 canonical set.

_oraclesComment: IOracle adapters (getPrice(base,quote)) usable as `priceOracle` in SwapPermission config. SwapPermission requires a non-zero IOracle adapter. Keyed chainId -> label. `pairs` lists the directional token pairs each adapter serves (both directions); any other pair reverts. catalog.mjs surfaces these so the swap skill can pick a default oracle.

UniV3TwapOracle-USDC-WETH.note: Default priceOracle for the USDC<->WETH pair on Unichain. Live 30-min TWAP from the 0.05% V3 pool (cardinality 2000); updatedAt = block.timestamp, so it is always fresh against maxPriceAgeSec. Manipulation resistance scales with pool liquidity + window; reads a single pool. Use with maxPriceAgeSec >= a few minutes.
